These data sets include simulation outputs, system identification records, and configuration information for the measurement systems deployed at the hybrid plant. The primary categories of data resources produced under this award are summarized below. (1) EMT Simulation Data Resources A broad set of EMT simulation results was produced through the multi-round studies conducted under Task 1 and Task 3. These data resources include: • Disturbance-response trajectories from GFM BESS, GFM wind, and mixed GFM/GFL configurations, covering phase jumps, voltage steps, frequency events, and weak-grid operating points. • Stability and interaction response plots generated as part of the preliminary EMT interaction study, characterizing active/reactive power dynamics, current-limiting behavior, and voltage recovery. • Scenario-level results corresponding to multiple SCR conditions and plant- controller configurations. Page 30 of 36 Award Number: DE-EE0010651 Recipient Name: Portland General Electric These results are documented in simulation outputs, figures, and analytical summaries that inform subsequent model tuning, hybrid-plant design, and future field validation activities. (2) Preliminary System-Identification Records from EMT and HIL Studies During BP1, preliminary system-identification-oriented data were generated from both EMT simulations and real-time HIL evaluations. These include: • Controller-in-the-loop (C-HiL) step-response traces, reflecting inverter-control response, timing, and stability margins. • Hybrid-plant controller interaction records, including PQ-meter response, amplifier interface behavior, and real-time latency measurements from the HIL testbed. • Parameter-sensitivity observations derived from EMT studies, supporting later tuning and validation tasks planned for BP2. While full parameter-estimation activities were scheduled for BP2, the available records provide a foundational basis for future system-identification and model- calibration work. (3) Measurement-System Configuration and Metadata (Site Deployment) As part of Task 7, the project completed installation and configuration of high-speed measurement systems at the Wheatridge hybrid plant.
